# CLAUDE.md — `cambera-ai/cambera-ai.github.io`

The only public website (HTML, GitHub Pages). Part of Cambera: an AI-native design-to-production platform for
precast concrete. This file is what Claude Code reads on every session in this clone.

## Environment

No build and no test suite — this repository holds documents, not code.

CI: Pages build on push to main.

**Repository-specific: Public. Polish copy goes through the miodkuj style pass; render a mock and look at it before pushing.**

## Two agents work on this repository

Viktor (the cloud agent, `@viktor` in Slack) takes cards from `obsidian-vault/Cambera/BACKLOG.md`
and works on branches `slice/*`. You are the local one. Do not race him:

- **Branch prefix `local/<topic>`.** Never work on `slice/*`, never commit to `main`.
- **One branch per repository at a time** (rule 25). Before you start, read
  `obsidian-vault/Cambera/IN_FLIGHT.md`; a row naming this repository means it is taken.
- **Merging:** repositories with CI are merged by Viktor after a green run (rule 15); repositories
  without CI are merged by whoever opened the PR, immediately. Releases and engineering
  arbitration are Jakub's (rule 4).
- A generated file in conflict is never merged by hand — rerun its generator.
- `.github/workflows/*` is off limits for both of us: the cloud token has no `workflows` scope,
  so a change there desynchronises us silently. Ask Jakub.

## House rules (this repository has no AGENTS.md yet)

- **Language (rule 14): everything inside a repository is English** — identifiers, comments,
  commit messages, docs. Polish belongs in `obsidian-vault` notes and in user-facing messages.
- **The vault is the source of truth** (rule 1). A decision living only in a commit message or in
  Slack does not exist.
- **Never invent numbers.** Versions, coverage, counts, prices — read them from the generated file
  that owns them, or say you cannot.
- **Norm citations carry the printed page** (clause + page of the PN-EN print), never from memory.
  Refer to clause numbers; never quote the text of a standard (CEN/PKN copyright).
- Secrets, client drawings and plant data never enter a commit.

## When you finish

1. Run the repository's own test command — the whole suite, once, at the end.
2. Open a PR from `local/<topic>`; put the *why* in the description, not in the code.
3. If the change teaches a lasting rule, add it to `obsidian-vault/Cambera/Zasady wspolpracy.md`
   (rule 2) — otherwise the next session relearns it the hard way.
